card.name: Linking words in dose instructions
card.fires_on: Small joining words or symbols right after a dose or value in dosing tables: "with", "Use", ";" and the plus-minus sign "±" after a number.

modes.label: with after a dose
modes.description: The word "with" or "a" following a dose, introducing a condition such as monitoring or a meal.
modes.example: 100 mg once daily<< with>> close monitoring for adverse reactions Consider lowering to

modes.label: Plus-minus after a number
modes.description: The sign ± placed after a number to give a range or tolerance.
modes.example: maintenance hemoglobin of either 14<< ±>> 1 g/dL or 1

modes.label: The word "Use" after a heading colon
modes.description: The word "Use" opening an instruction after a patient-group heading and colon.
modes.example: Renal Impairment :<< Use>> the lowest recommended starting dose or increase the
